mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is declining, or the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS trend is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 8.0%, it signals persistent labor market weakness that triggers a flight to safety, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 8.0%, or the Rank IC for UNRATE threshold is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between a rising federal funds rate and a high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 8.0%) indicates a monetary tightening cycle amid weak labor conditions, which predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE > 8.0%, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-recession recovery regime, rising housing starts (HOUST) signal strengthening demand conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods during the post-recession recovery regime, or the Rank IC for HOUST in this regime is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust supply chain activity and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is rising, or the Rank IC for INDPRO trend is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 650.0 thousand units, it signals a contraction in residential demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 650.0, or the Rank IC for HOUST threshold is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between declining housing starts (HOUST) and falling industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a simultaneous demand and supply contraction, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST falls and INDPRO falls, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, rising federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS > 0.5%) predict negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS in tightening cycles is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
